covers: The pins of the NEC uPD1990A and uPD4990A, as MAME's handlers expose them

entries.name: oe_w
entries.description: The output enable pin of DATA OUT.
entries.behaviour: While OE is low, DATA OUT reads 1 (high impedance), except in test mode. A change of OE, unless the latched command is test mode, sends the resulting DATA OUT level to the data callback.

entries.name: cs_w
entries.behaviour: While CS is low, STB and CLK are ignored completely, so no command is latched and nothing shifts. The C pins, DATA IN and OE are still stored; CS is a level and has no edge action.

entries.name: stb_w
entries.description: The strobe pin: a rising edge latches and runs the command.
entries.behaviour: Needs CS high and a 0 to 1 change. The command is the C pin value, except that value 7 means test mode on a 1990A and, on a 4990A, takes the 4-bit command from the serial command register instead. See upd1990a-commands.

entries.name: clk_w
entries.description: The shift clock pin: a rising edge shifts the register.
entries.behaviour: Needs CS high. It shifts the time register right only while the latched command is 1 (shift). On a 4990A with the C pins at 7 every edge also shifts the 4-bit command register, DATA IN entering at its top bit, and its outgoing bit feeds the time register instead of DATA IN.

entries.name: c0_w
entries.behaviour: Only stored; nothing happens until STB rises. The value should be 0 or 1 because it is merged unmasked.

entries.name: c1_w
entries.behaviour: Only stored; nothing happens until STB rises. The value should be 0 or 1 because it is merged unmasked.

entries.name: c2_w
entries.behaviour: Only stored; nothing happens until STB rises. On a 4990A, all three pins high at that moment (and at each CLK) selects the serial command mode.

entries.name: data_in_w
entries.behaviour: Only stored. It is sampled at each rising CLK: it enters the top of the time register under the shift command, or the top of the 4-bit command register in the 4990A serial mode.

entries.name: data_out_r
entries.behaviour: Returns 1 when OE is low unless in test mode. Otherwise bit 0 of the time register after a strobe or shift, or a square wave under hold and read commands (see upd1990a-commands). Each change also goes to the data callback.

entries.name: tp_r
entries.description: Reads the TP time pulse pin.
entries.behaviour: Returns the current level of a square wave the commands set (64 Hz after hold, other rates by command), low at start; only time set in test mode stops it, low. Each toggle also goes to the TP callback.
